task: Explain pi compaction: findCutPoint oversized user spans, compact summary merge, and context token estimation
setup: Two fresh clones of pi HEAD with identical tracked files. Both agents received exactly the same task text and the same cm binary/instructions. Both stores had an active fair-pi frame; the treatment store had 20 user memories plus 4 frames, the control store had only the frame. No brief was pre-injected; agents had to call cm themselves.
notes: Equal-tools runs: same prompt, model, repo commit, cm binary, and tool access. Only memory store contents differed. All six answers were source-correct in spot review against findValidCutPoints (394), findCutPoint (446), compact (952), and tokensBefore (884).
